description.value: Waterfront campsites on Howe Sound with mountain views across BC's southernmost fjord, plus dedicated scuba-diving facilities; an active rail line borders the park bringing periodic train noise, sites are tightly spaced, and a 7-night-per-year cap limits lingering.
